review:
A cosy cat café made with a Malta-based studio, with mechanics Asian-market players will recognise and four Cats Jackpot prizes.

Its quirk is Fast 100 Spins: buy it and the game plays 100 rounds in a row, where free spins, jackpots and the max win can all still hit – and you can stop part-way, paying only for what's been played. There's also a straight free spins buy. Medium-high volatility, 1,500x max, 96.07% RTP, and free spins come often – roughly once every 93 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 93 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
